unit: Unit 13: Making Your Computer Easier to Use
title: Zoom or text size?
drDigitalIntro:
Two settings make things bigger, and they are not interchangeable.
• Text Size changes every menu, button and label on the whole computer, in every app.
• Browser zoom changes one website, and only inside the browser.
• Use Text Size if everything feels small. Use zoom if one particular page is the problem.
• In this activity you will read a long article by zooming it, without touching the computer-wide setting.

playgroundTask.goal: You zoomed an article to read it comfortably

steps.say: Type gardeningtips.example into the address bar and press Enter.
Zoom in so the article text is comfortable to read.

drDigitalSuccess: That article is now set the way you like it, and the rest of the computer is untouched.
drDigitalHint: Zoom lives in the browser toolbar, not in Settings. Look for the percentage on the right of the grey button row.
